name: Permissive control device
summary: Permits or prevents an equipment operation according to a selected control condition.
description: Permits or prevents an equipment operation according to a selected control condition.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the permissive selector or control input. The associated drawing should trace the inhibited or enabled operating command; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the permissive selector or control input.
Trace the inhibited or enabled operating command.
drawingChecklist: Label the permissive selector or control input.
Cross-reference the inhibited or enabled operating command.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: A permissive control establishes command authority; a numbered interlocking relay may separately verify apparatus state.
